load_inference_model_from_checkpoint: load a PyTorch inference model from a checkpoint file with optional EMA weights and config overrides
load_tasks_from_checkpoint: load and instantiate Task objects from a checkpoint file's tasks_config
get_backbone_class_from_checkpoint: extract the backbone model class from a checkpoint's config using the fairchem registry
update_configs_recursive_merge: recursively merge new config values into an existing config dict or DictConfig
enable_tf32_precision_context: use a context manager to temporarily enable TF32 precision for CUDA matmul and cuDNN operations
